title: Danby — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Danby.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Canadian Comfort." Value tier. Danby is headquartered in Guelph, Ontario and specializes in compact and specialty appliances — bar fridges, beverage centers, wine coolers, freezers, dehumidifiers, and portable air conditioners. Their Silhouette brand covers the premium compact segment. Danby is the go-to for secondary appliances and small-space solutions across Canada.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Condos, dorms, offices, garages, basements — anywhere a compact or secondary appliance is needed. Canadian retailers stocking specialty cooling.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Danby:

• Canadian company — Guelph, Ontario headquarters

• Market leader in compact and specialty appliances

• Silhouette premium line for built-in beverage and wine storage

• Widest selection of bar fridges, beverage centers, and mini-fridges in Canada

• Energy Star certified across most of the lineup
